# Oil Rig model credit

`OilRig2.stl` is [Oil Rig](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/oil-rig-2a9fadae585f4bbfa030772e54e64ace) by
[AnsysLearn](https://sketchfab.com/AnsysLearn), licensed under
[CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

`sim/build_full_rig.py` changes the model for this project. It splits the mesh into parts, rescales it,
adds UVs, smoothed normals, materials and textures, and places it in an ocean scene. The original author
doesn't endorse this project.
